subject.title: Control UI: Pinned context panel for user-defined persistent facts

question: Should pinned facts be a first-party Control UI memory/context feature, a generic workspace-file manager slice, or a plugin Control UI contribution, and what storage plus injection semantics should it use?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing the owner boundary and trust model changes persistent prompt context and browser write access, so automation should not pick the product/API direction.

options.title: Decide pinned-context semantics first
options.body: Keep this issue open as the focused product/security decision for storage, freshness labels, injection guarantees, and write UX before an implementation PR.

options.title: Fold into memory/workspace files
options.body: Make the generic memory or workspace file surface the implementation owner, then close this only after it supports structured pinned facts safely.

options.title: Route through plugin UI slots
options.body: Use this as a concrete consumer of the broader Control UI contribution-slot RFC and avoid a bespoke core panel until that API is settled.

recommendation.title: Decide pinned-context semantics first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the focused product/security decision for storage, freshness labels, injection guarantees, and write UX before an implementation PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest inspected history across the Agent Files safety boundary and Agents UI split that constrain this decision.
